title: 'the first time you play a non-token gear each turn' trigger never fires
expected: Jayce (ven-068a-166) has no hand-authored ability; runtime parse (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/trigger-patterns.ts:435-438) yields trigger {event:"play-self-or-play-gear", on:"self"} with a raw effect. In riftbound-engine/src/abilities/trigger-matcher.ts:346-350, the on:"self" branch rejects any event whose cardId != the ability holder's id. play-gear.ts:269 fires {type:"play-card", cardId:<gear>, cardType:"gear"}, so the "play-gear" half of the compound matches the event type (line 321-323) but is then rejected because event.cardId (Seal of Discord) !== Jayce's id. Verified by calling findMatchingTriggers directly: play-card/gear event with Jayce in base returns [] while play-self returns the match. So the gear-play trigger can never fire (additionally the effect is type:"raw", so even the play-self half would do nothing useful).
observed: playGear resolved, Seal of Discord entered base, chain=null and pendingChoice=null; no Jayce trigger
